paras: A TV unit keeps your TV, decoder, speakers and decor in one neat place. Ours starts at 180 cm wide, 40 cm deep and 50 cm high, and we can make it wider or lower to suit your wall and your TV size.

Tell us the size of your TV and the wall it will stand against, and we will plan the shelves and doors with you. We can leave space for cables and a decoder so everything stays tidy. You can choose the finish to match your sofa set and centre table.
faq: Can the TV unit be made for a bigger TV?
Yes. Send us your TV size and the wall width and we will make the unit to fit.
